findings.summary: The holdLifted back-off reset only runs inside wakeIdleExecutors, which is called only when there are idle executors and tasks. If the tick carrying holdLifted has neither, the signal is dropped and a stale back-off can delay the next wake by one tick. Harmless; could clear lastWoke in tick before the idle.length && tasks.length check.
